metadata.title: A torus-collar proof of the real-spectrum compact-support classification for Nijenhuis operators
metadata.description:
This note gives an explicit complete smooth compact-support proof answering the historical Problem 5.11 as printed in arXiv:1804.03737v2. In every dimension n >= 1, precisely the all-real-spectrum Jordan types occur on a nonempty open subset of R^n for globally smooth compactly supported real Nijenhuis operators, with arbitrary prescribed numerical real Jordan data in a commuting local frame. Type and eigenvalues may change elsewhere. The proof gives the full ordered collar equation, finite block removal path, same-dimensional torus embedding and exact zero extension.

The nonreal obstruction, real semisimple and two-dimensional examples, local arbitrary-type point realizations, and splitting/holomorphic mechanism are credited prior results. A precise zero-point rigidity argument avoids an imprecise polynomial-reduction sentence in the inspected author version; the unread publisher body is not equated to it. Full-result and construction-method priority, novelty and worldwide preexisting openness remain UNKNOWN. This is an attributed complete proof of the printed historical question, without a firstness claim.

AI tools were used extensively in solving, source comparison, adversarial verification and writing. This work is unrefereed, without external human peer review, journal acceptance or formal proof-assistant certification. The supporting kit contains the complete manuscript source, newly written exact standard-library controls, custody records and bounded source-read ledgers. Finite checks corroborate the proof and do not reconstruct historical omitted programs.
